arStrings.szText: Gain {c_number}[{SF_63}*100|%|]{/c} Dodge Chance when you Cast {c_important}Flurry{/c} and have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}
{c_important}Flurry{/c} now damages enemies in a circle around you and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Flurry{/c} is also a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill.

Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, dashes you to the target, and grants {c_number}[{SF_61}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Movement Speed for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEB_MOVEMENT_SPEED_BONUS}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Flurry's{/c} size is increased by {c_number}[{SF_52}|x%|]{/c} and its Energy Cost is reduced to {c_number}{SF_36}{/c}. {c_important}Flurry{/c} now also gains {c_number}[{SF_53}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage each time it hits an enemy, up to {c_number}[{SF_53}*{SF_54}*100|x%|]{/c}, for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BONUS}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Fortify{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_59}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} when {c_important}Flurry{/c} hits an enemy for the first time.
Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[SF_43 * 100|%x|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_43}*{SF_35}*100|%x|]{/c}. This bonus resets after hitting the maximum.
Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_63} * 100|%|]{/c} Dodge Chance for {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE_4_DODGE}{/c} seconds while you have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
